summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any tests or repository code; nothing was committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title), the wrapper's existing method. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (returns early on legacy Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Verification was by reading only; the tests have not been run.
